articles.summary: Leaders from Australia’s Northern Territory visited H&P’s Galena Park facility for a firsthand look at the company’s rig refurbishment and commissioning operations. The visit began with a brief introduction and overview of the site’s layout before the group toured the facility to observe the workflow of a rig moving through upgrades and modifications. articles.title: H&P Hosts the Australian Northern Territory Delegation at Galena Park
